reason: My guests find me on Booking.com, Google Maps and Facebook, and I've never needed a website. Six hundred euros plus a monthly fee for a site I'd hardly touch doesn't feel urgent while the bookings keep coming.
objection: A website doesn't bring guests by itself. People still search on Booking, so I'd pay €600 and €15 every month and maybe still get no direct bookings.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from another villa or apartment owner nearby that their site brought real direct bookings in the first season, enough to save more than it cost in Booking commission.
